targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours';
SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';

panels.title: Unique TG users (24h)
panels.description: Distinct Telegram user_id values from scenario.user_id over the last 24h. Web-only sessions (no init_data) aren't counted — open in @citysignalllbot to show up here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_id') AS users FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_id' IS NOT NULL;
SELECT count(*) AS errors FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND (type LIKE 'error.%' OR status='error');
SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

WITH events_window AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT step AS metric, n AS value FROM (VALUES ('1. landed (page.view)', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM events_window WHERE type='page.view' AND payload->'scenario'->>'route'='/pipe-swipe-train')), ('2. saw a card', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM events_window WHERE type='swipe_train.card.view')), ('3. swiped at least once', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM events_window WHERE type IN ('swipe_train.card.like','swipe_train.card.skip'))), ('4. liked at least once', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM events_window WHERE type='swipe_train.card.like')), ('5. finished deck', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM events_window WHERE type='swipe_train.deck.complete'))) AS t(step, n) WHERE n IS NOT NULL;

SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'primary_tag' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND type='swipe_train.card.like' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND payload->'scenario'->>'primary_tag' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12;

WITH ew AS (SELECT * FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT step AS metric, n AS value FROM (VALUES ('Q1 view', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='quiz.step.view' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'step')::int=0)), ('Q2 view', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='quiz.step.view' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'step')::int=1)), ('Q3 view', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='quiz.step.view' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'step')::int=2)), ('Q4 view', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='quiz.step.view' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'step')::int=3)), ('complete', (SELECT count(DISTINCT request_id) FROM ew WHERE type='quiz.complete'))) AS t(step, n) WHERE n IS NOT NULL;

SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'route' AS route, count(*) AS views, count(DISTINCT request_id) AS sessions FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND type='page.view' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25;

SELECT received_at AS time, type, payload->'scenario'->>'route' AS route, COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'message', data) AS message FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND (type LIKE 'error.%' OR status='error') AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', received_at) AS time, payload->'scenario'->>'route' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'value_ms')::numeric) AS value FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND type='perf.lcp' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND payload->'scenario'->>'value_ms' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE service='citysignal' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 30;
